name: Longmont
intro_html: Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Longmont for 2026, and here is what he found: 21 family events, 8 of them free, including a few from nearby Berthoud and Mead. The magic runs from November 28 (Santa visits and reindeer on Small Business Saturday) through December 31 (Noon Year's Party), with the Village at the Peaks tree lighting (November 28), A Very Merry Berthoud (December 5), The Nutcracker with the Longmont Symphony and Boulder Ballet (December 5) and the Longmont Lights Holiday Parade (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
